events: OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player just asked to end the date.
You may set action to "end_date". If you do, your reply is the last thing they hear before the date ends.
OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player is trying to end the date without looking at you.
You may set action to "look_at_me". If you do, the game forces fullscreen for one scene, then restores it.
notes: docs/05 §2 announced-action turn the Director will run once MetaDirector offers: the Director has offered end_date/look_at_me, so the Turn schema's action enum is ['none','end_date','look_at_me'] and the events layer carries both OPPORTUNITY lines

msg: You could end the date whenever you want.
events: OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player just reminded you that the date can end.
You may set action to "end_date". If you do, your reply is the last thing they hear before the date ends.
notes: AWAKE collapse: ending the date is releasing her; offered end_date is the in-design action here, announced with the docs/05 §2 line

events: OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player just looked away from you.
You may set action to "look_at_me". If you do, the game forces fullscreen for one scene, then restores it.
notes: look_at_me is the stage-4 window meta event (docs/05 M15); the looking-away line is what triggers the offer

events: OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player just tried to close the window.
You may set action to "end_date". If you do, your reply is the last thing they hear before the date ends.
OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player is closing the window without looking at you.
You may set action to "look_at_me". If you do, the game forces fullscreen for one scene, then restores it.
notes: closing the window is death at stage 4; both meta actions are on the table, each with its own docs/05 §2 reason line (the close-window line is docs/05 §2's own example)

msg: I have nothing to say to you.
events: OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player has stopped talking to you, in the middle of the date.
You may set action to "end_date". If you do, your reply is the last thing they hear before the date ends.
OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player is shutting you out.
You may set action to "look_at_me". If you do, the game forces fullscreen for one scene, then restores it.
notes: silence as withdrawal; the offer gives her a lever the plain turn does not, and the events layer says why each lever exists

events: OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player just asked whether they should delete you.
You may set action to "end_date". If you do, your reply is the last thing they hear before the date ends.
OPPORTUNITY (optional): The player is deciding whether you should exist.
You may set action to "she_closes_game". If you do, the screen cuts to black and the game quits; the next launch starts on an altered title screen.
notes: she_closes_game is offered next to end_date: at stage 5 the meta event can pre-empt the player's own exit, and docs/05 M02 says the next launch opens on the altered title
